notes: History has a new look: the search bar is at the top, conversations have more breathing room, and the bottom bar stays with you
Skills page: Saved Prompts is now a full-width button under the title, with roomier skill rows
The skill tag above the chat box now shows the Skills icon, and its prompt card matches the new design
Menu icons refreshed for Waya Score, How Skills works, FAQs, Privacy Policy and Terms
Fixed: closing History after visiting Watch To Buy now takes you back to the main screen
The How It Works tutorial tab now slides out from behind the top bar instead of floating below it
How Watch to Buy and How Skills icons now match their real bottom-bar icons, and Waya Score now uses a scale icon
The skill tag shown in chat now matches the latest design: a soft white pill with a grey outline
Redesigned menu icons for a cleaner, consistent look
Age is now locked after sign-up, just like your mobile, email and gender
Profile picture is a soft pastel colour with your initial, with a plain grey ring
Your mobile number, email and gender are now locked in your profile - they are set during sign-up and shown with a lock, so they cannot be changed by accident
You can still edit your name, age and city any time
Your profile picture is now your initial - a coloured circle with the first letter of your name - instead of a stock photo. Change your name and it updates automatically
The bottom bar is now exactly the same height in WayaX AI and In-House Research, so it no longer jumps when you switch between them
Tapping a bar button smoothly widens it with a gentle, flowing highlight (no more bounce)
Edit Profile now shows everything from sign-up: your city, gender and a Verified badge on your mobile number
Profile has friendly checks (age, email) and warns you if you leave without saving
More breathing room between the chat box and the keyboard, on every screen where you type
Bottom bar: Chats is now History, New Chat moves to the centre with the X mark, and the bar is a little taller
Waya MCX card uses the real MCX logo mark
Bottom bar: the selected tab is highlighted with the new glass pill
Waya Apps: FnO tag label
New Other Waya Apps page (menu → Waya Apps) with Waya FnO and Waya MCX
Opening the app on a new chat now brings up the keyboard, ready to type
Same when you come back to the app or tap New Chat
New side menu that matches the Figma design
Waya Score explainer pops up from the menu
New Usage, FAQs, Privacy Policy, Terms and About Us pages
How Watch to Buy / Skills works: plays the tutorial once, then hides it
Score dropdown removed from the top right
Fixed the X in "Welcome to WayaX AI"
Logo and greeting move up when the keyboard opens, and the blue/green glow sits right on top of the keyboard
The WayaX AI chat box now uses the same white outlined bar as the other screens

Pinned chats stay at the top of the list with a pin icon
Chats: close button and refreshed empty state
Skills: chevrons on every skill; your own skills get edit and delete icons
Edit Skill: add several prompts, remove any prompt, Delete or Save (Figma)
New 7-step sign-up and sign-in screens (Figma), with error states for invalid number, wrong OTP and minimum age
Testing: a quiet "Test flow" button on the intro lets you pick New sign-up, Sign in or the original 3-step flow
Subtle haptic tick when swiping between WayaX AI and In House Research

Light gray edit pencil, taller Add Skill sheet, new Stock Recommendation prompts
Fixed Skills title hiding under the header when Tutorials are off

Added an Edit option for skills you create
Fixed the Skills icon clipping; New Chat icon now matches the Figma design
Removed the Skip label from the intro video
Fixed header overlapping content on Watch To Buy and the Waya Score card
New intro wording: Curious Minds Deserves / Decisive Answers
Fixed the New Chat nav icon
Added a New Chat button to the bottom nav bar
Tap a skill to pin it above the search bar, then tap it again for ready-made prompt questions for that skill
New opening animation when you launch the app — now a smooth, always-crisp video instead of a live-drawn effect, so it plays the same on every phone
Same layout on every phone: screens now scale to your screen size, so nothing crowds or cuts off on smaller or larger phones
Full screen behind the status and navigation bars, chat box above the keyboard, and design-sized text (from 1.2)
